description: This file defines a builder class (LoanBuilder) used for constructing Loan objects for testing purposes within the Apache Fineract project. It encapsulates methods to set various properties of a Loan and builds instances via reflection, primarily for unit testing scenarios.

classes.name: LoanBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing Loan objects with customizable properties, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates a Loan object instance using reflection, setting various properties based on the builder's state.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the loan to be built.

methods.name: withAccountNo
methods.description: Sets the account number for the loan.

methods.name: withClient
methods.description: Sets the client associated with the loan.

methods.name: withGroup
methods.description: Sets the group associated with the loan.

methods.name: withLoanType
methods.description: Sets the type of the loan (e.g., individual, group).

methods.name: withLoanProduct
methods.description: Sets the loan product details.

methods.name: withFund
methods.description: Associates a fund with the loan.

methods.name: withLoanOfficer
methods.description: Sets the loan officer associated with the loan.

methods.name: withLoanPurpose
methods.description: Specifies the purpose of the loan.

methods.name: withTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Sets the transaction processor for repayment schedule processing.

methods.name: withLoanRepaymentScheduleDetail
methods.description: Sets the loan repayment schedule details.

methods.name: withLoanStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the loan.

methods.name: withLoanSubStatus
methods.description: Sets the sub-status of the loan.

methods.name: withCharges
methods.description: Sets the loan charges.

methods.name: withCollateral
methods.description: Sets the collateral management details.

methods.name: withSyncDisbursementWithMeeting
methods.description: Sets whether disbursement is synchronized with meetings.

methods.name: withFixedEmiAmount
methods.description: Sets the fixed EMI amount.

methods.name: withDisbursementDetails
methods.description: Sets the disbursement details.

methods.name: withMaxOutstandingLoanBalance
methods.description: Sets the maximum outstanding loan balance.

methods.name: withCreateStandingInstructionAtDisbursement
methods.description: Indicates if standing instructions are created at disbursement.

methods.name: withInterestRateDifferential
methods.description: Sets the interest rate differential.

methods.name: withRates
methods.description: Sets applicable rates.

methods.name: withFixedPrincipalPercentagePerInstallment
methods.description: Sets the fixed principal percentage per installment.

methods.name: withExternalId
methods.description: Sets an external identifier for the loan.

methods.name: withLoanApplicationTerms
methods.description: Sets the loan application terms.

methods.name: withEnableInstallmentLevelDelinquency
methods.description: Enables installment level delinquency.

methods.name: withSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Sets the date the loan was submitted.

methods.name: withApprovedOnDate
methods.description: Sets the approval date.

methods.name: withExpectedDisbursementDate
methods.description: Sets the expected disbursement date.

methods.name: withActualDisbursementDate
methods.description: Sets the actual disbursement date.

methods.name: withClosedOnDate
methods.description: Sets the date the loan was closed.

methods.name: withClosedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who closed the loan.

methods.name: withWrittenOffOnDate
methods.description: Sets the date the loan was written off.

methods.name: withWriteOffReason
methods.description: Sets the reason for write-off.

methods.name: withChargedOff
methods.description: Flags the loan as charged off.

methods.name: withChargeOffReason
methods.description: Sets the charge-off reason.

methods.name: withChargedOffOnDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the loan was charged off.

methods.name: withChargedOffBy
methods.description: Sets the user who charged off the loan.

methods.name: withProposedPrincipal
methods.description: Sets the proposed principal amount.

methods.name: withApprovedPrincipal
methods.description: Sets the approved principal amount.

methods.name: withNetDisbursalAmount
methods.description: Sets the net disbursal amount.

methods.name: withLoanTransactions
methods.description: Sets the list of loan transactions.

methods.name: withLoanTransaction
methods.description: Adds a single loan transaction to the list.

methods.name: withSummary
methods.description: Sets the loan summary.
